step1_analysis.circuit_type: Class-AB Adaptive Analog Video Line Driver
step1_analysis.description: A single-ended to differential video line driver utilizing a class-AB structure. It features a non-inverting source-follower path and an inverting path to drive a differential load or two single-ended 75-ohm lines.

paper_reference.title: A 3.3-V CMOS Adaptive Analog Video Line Driver With Low Distortion Performance

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipation from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Bias currents (Vgs=0.9V) ~0.5mA. Output currents into 75 ohm loads ~3mA. Total current ~3.5mA. Power = 1.8V * 3.5mA = 6.3mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down for 1.8V supply and the specific 5u/0.5u transistor sizes in the netlist.

voltage_gain_non_inverting.description: Low frequency AC voltage gain from input N5 to output N6.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm of output NMOS ~ 3.7mS. Rout = 1/gm = 270 ohms. Gain = 75 / (75 + 270) = 0.21 = -13.5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 5u/0.5u devices are too small to drive 75 ohms efficiently, resulting in significant attenuation.

voltage_gain_inverting.description: Low frequency AC voltage gain from input N5 to output N3.

sky130_expected.calculation: Similar attenuation expected due to small PMOS drive strength into 75 ohm load.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric sizing implies similar output impedance and attenuation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pole = 1 / (2*pi*Rout*Cload). With Rout~270 ohms and parasitic C~50fF, BW > 10 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Small devices have very low parasitic capacitance, pushing the pole to very high frequencies.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the output for a given input.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the severe attenuation of the small output devices driving a heavy 75 ohm load.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient swing of the video line driver with 75-ohm loads.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Video Line Driver
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 N7 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 N4 N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VDD N0 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 GND N5 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 LABEL_NET_2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 VDD N5 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N6 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9

* Input signal at N5
VIN N5 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.2 5Meg)

* 75-ohm loads for video line driver
R1 N6 0 75
R2 N3 0 75

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  ac dec 20 10k 10G
  let gain_n6_db = vdb(N6)
  let gain_n3_db = vdb(N3)
  meas ac low_freq_gain_n6 find gain_n6_db at=100k
  meas ac low_freq_gain_n3 find gain_n3_db at=100k
  
  let target_n6 = low_freq_gain_n6 - 3
  let target_n3 = low_freq_gain_n3 - 3
  meas ac bw_n6 when gain_n6_db=target_n6 fall=1
  meas ac bw_n3 when gain_n3_db=target_n3 fall=1

  tran 1n 1u
  meas tran v_max_n6 max v(N6)
  meas tran v_min_n6 min v(N6)
  let swing_n6 = v_max_n6 - v_min_n6
  print swing_n6
  
  meas tran v_max_n3 max v(N3)
  meas tran v_min_n3 min v(N3)
  let swing_n3 = v_max_n3 - v_min_n3
  print swing_n3
  
  quit
.endc
